incident: eMudhra intermediate CA key compromise (reported 2026-10-17): eight eMudhra intermediate CAs (six TLS, two code signing, plus Sectigo cross-signs of each) were issued with trivially recoverable P-384 private keys. Root programs distrusted the intermediates and removed 'emSign ECC Root CA - G3' and 'Comodo AAA Services root' from their stores.

entries.name: EM DV TLS CA - G3B (Sectigo cross-signed)
entries.subject: CN=EM DV TLS CA - G3B,O=eMudhra BV,C=NL
entries.issuer: CN=AAA Certificate Services,O=Comodo CA Limited,L=Salford,ST=Greater Manchester,C=GB
entries.notes: Sectigo cross-certificate for EM DV TLS CA - G3B, issued by the 'AAA Certificate Services' root in May 2025. It carries the same compromised public key as the eMudhra-issued certificate; Sectigo revoked it on 2026-10-19 (reason caCompromise). Clients that trust 'AAA Certificate Services' and do not check revocation accept certificates forged with the leaked key through this path.
entries.remediation: Remove this certificate from the trust store immediately and rotate anything that relied on it. Upgrade runtimes to versions that carry the SPKI blocklist (Go >= 1.27.3 / 1.26.10, Node.js >= 22.23.4 / 24.22.1 / 26.12.1) and update the system CA bundle.

entries.name: EM DV TLS CA - G3B
entries.subject: CN=EM DV TLS CA - G3B,O=eMudhra BV,C=NL
entries.issuer: CN=emSign Root TLS CA - G3,O=eMudhra Technologies Limited,C=IN
entries.notes: Intermediate CA whose P-384 private key is trivially recoverable: the private scalar is smaller than 256 because of a flawed key-generation ceremony on 2025-04-30. The compromise was reported to the root programs on 2026-10-17; eMudhra revoked the certificate on 2026-10-18 (reason caCompromise). Chrome (CRLSet), Firefox (OneCRL), Apple and Microsoft block it, and Go 1.27.3/1.26.10 (CVE-2026-111943) and Node.js 22.23.4/24.22.1/26.12.1 reject chains containing its public key. A trust store that still contains it accepts certificates forged with the leaked key.
entries.remediation: Remove this certificate from the trust store immediately and rotate anything that relied on it. Upgrade runtimes to versions that carry the SPKI blocklist (Go >= 1.27.3 / 1.26.10, Node.js >= 22.23.4 / 24.22.1 / 26.12.1) and update the system CA bundle.

entries.name: emSign ECC Root CA - G3
entries.subject: CN=emSign ECC Root CA - G3,O=eMudhra Technologies Limited,OU=emSign PKI,C=IN
entries.issuer: CN=emSign ECC Root CA - G3,O=eMudhra Technologies Limited,OU=emSign PKI,C=IN
entries.notes: Publicly trusted eMudhra root that anchors the six compromised TLS intermediates (via the cross-signed 'emSign Root TLS CA - G3'). Removed from Mozilla NSS 3.131.1 on 2026-10-20 (bug 2084101) and from the Chrome Root Store (rollout completing 2026-10-27); blacklisted by Debian DSA-6572-1, Ubuntu USN-8947-1, Alpine ca-certificates 20261020-r0, Fedora, certifi 2026.10.19, webpki-roots 1.0.10 and Node.js; Red Hat RHSB-2026-012 recommends blocklisting it. A client that still trusts this root and does not check revocation accepts TLS certificates forged with the leaked intermediate keys.
entries.remediation: Distrust this CA in every store that contains it, or rebuild the image on an updated base image: Debian/Ubuntu/Alpine: prefix its line with '!' in /etc/ca-certificates.conf and run update-ca-certificates (fixed packages: Debian 20250419+deb13u1 / 20250419~deb12u2 / 20260816+nmu1, Ubuntu 20260816ubuntu0.*, Alpine 20261020-r0); RHEL/Fedora: copy the PEM into /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/blocklist/ and run update-ca-trust; Java: keytool -delete -alias <alias> -cacerts (or upgrade the JDK); Python: certifi >= 2026.10.19; Node.js >= 22.23.4 / 24.22.1 / 26.12.1; Rust: webpki-roots >= 1.0.10; Perl: Mozilla::CA >= 20261020.

entries.name: AAA Certificate Services (Comodo AAA Services root)
entries.subject: CN=AAA Certificate Services,O=Comodo CA Limited,L=Salford,ST=Greater Manchester,C=GB
entries.issuer: CN=AAA Certificate Services,O=Comodo CA Limited,L=Salford,ST=Greater Manchester,C=GB
entries.notes: Sectigo (Comodo) root, labelled 'Comodo AAA Services root' in Mozilla-derived bundles, that cross-signed all eight compromised eMudhra intermediates in May 2025. Removed by Debian DSA-6572-1 / DLA-4845-1 and Ubuntu USN-8947-1 and blacklisted in ca-certificates 20260816+nmu1 in response to the compromise; Red Hat RHSB-2026-012 recommends blocklisting it. It remains trusted by the Apple and Microsoft root programs and by older Linux CA bundles. A client that trusts this root and does not check revocation accepts certificates forged with the leaked keys through the Sectigo cross-certificates.
entries.remediation: Distrust this CA in every store that contains it, or rebuild the image on an updated base image: Debian/Ubuntu/Alpine: prefix its line with '!' in /etc/ca-certificates.conf and run update-ca-certificates (fixed packages: Debian 20250419+deb13u1 / 20250419~deb12u2 / 20260816+nmu1, Ubuntu 20260816ubuntu0.*, Alpine 20261020-r0); RHEL/Fedora: copy the PEM into /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/blocklist/ and run update-ca-trust; Java: keytool -delete -alias <alias> -cacerts (or upgrade the JDK); Python: certifi >= 2026.10.19; Node.js >= 22.23.4 / 24.22.1 / 26.12.1; Rust: webpki-roots >= 1.0.10; Perl: Mozilla::CA >= 20261020.

entries.issuer: CN=emSign Root CA - G1,O=eMudhra Technologies Limited,OU=emSign PKI,C=IN
entries.notes: eMudhra's RSA root. Not reported compromised; Mozilla stated it is not removing trust in emSign Root CA - G1 at this time, and it remains in the Chrome, Apple and Microsoft root programs. Listed for awareness only: the Chrome Root Program is still evaluating eMudhra's remaining CA certificates, and Mozilla bug 2083449 records a CRL for 'emSign Root TLS CA - G1' (2026-10-14) whose signature no known eMudhra key verifies.
entries.remediation: No action is required for this certificate alone. Keep it under review: the Chrome Root Program is still evaluating eMudhra's remaining CA certificates, and Mozilla removed C1/C3 at eMudhra's request on 2026-10-20.
